# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-04

- First version: Slack remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint taken from the vendor's plugin repository (`slackapi/slack-mcp-plugin`, commit `ad6be88`).
- The vendor's OAuth client ID and callback port are not copied. BoldCreate Connect supplies its own OAuth client.
